known.title: Failed-check reason sentence is partly hardcoded.
known.detail: In the "missing" branch the sentence lists what is missing correctly, but the checks pill starts collapsed. A site failing only on HTTPS can be misread until the pill is expanded. Queued follow-up.

known.title: "I detected {platform} from your site" copy on the CopilotStrip.
known.detail: Shown even when the platform came from `?type=` or a manual pick. Queued follow-up.

known.title: Site URL pencil on Settings › Installation persists via PATCH.
known.detail: Everything else on that page is session-only. Whether to suppress the pencil there is an open product decision (one host flag). Test it as it is (K9).

known.title: `fallback: true` is not an error.
known.detail: Model failure, busy lock and hourly/daily cap all return 200 with usable default content. On an environment without a model key every response is a fallback.

known.title: Free plan gates in the wizard mirror the dashboard.
known.detail: Locked rows, gated chips and the chat widget limit open the same FeatureGateUpgrade / ChatWidgetUpgradeGate popups. A completed in-flow upgrade lifts the gates immediately.

known.title: Notification previews use the session's pinned site date.
known.detail: After a header site switch on a multi-site account the preview apex (pushengage.com vs trypushengage.com) may follow the wrong site. Pre-existing staleness that this PR makes visible; log as a finding.

known.title: Web and app recommendation tracks share one Redis lock.
known.detail: A simultaneous cross-track burst can cost a ~12 s wait then the static catalog. Cosmetic in real use.

known.title: `installation-details` detection dropped its host anchor.
known.detail: A page with an unrelated script at a path containing `core/<siteId>.js` can read as installed. Rare; report with the page if you hit it.

known.title: Two comment drifts in the backend.
known.detail: `Catalog/web.js` says "Workflows (7)" but there are 6; the validator comment mentions 422 where the API returns 400. Not behaviour.

known.title: `src/App.test.tsx` does not run.
known.detail: Stock Create React App scaffold test, failing on master too. Unrelated.

known.title: Functional backend tests 401 locally with a stale `.env.testing`.
known.detail: Set `SETUP_TEST_ACCOUNT=true` with `TEST_ACCOUNT_EMAIL` / `TEST_ACCOUNT_PASSWORD` to mint a fresh account per run (see test/README.md).
